metric: Adjusted Rand Index; agreement of partitions, not accuracy or a percentage
evaluated_partition: Final leaf partition at resolution_level 6; not an average over all levels

frozen_subsampling.grouping: Identical base input vector hashes are sampled together
frozen_subsampling.comparison: Pairwise intersection of CVE IDs, aligned to the same order; no manual matching of cluster numbers

interpretation.one: Identical partitions up to cluster-ID permutation
interpretation.negative: Less agreement than expected by chance
interpretation.limitations: Stability does not establish correct vulnerability types, operational question compatibility, exploitability, or VEX accuracy. Run pairs are correlated; dispersion is not a confidence interval.
